author_approval: Kirk LaSalle approved the restricted Higgs-portal test and the published joint-contour compatibility screen.
registration_scope: Local prospective protocol recorded before numerical contour coordinates were inspected; not an external preregistration.

hypothesis.bulk: flat R^(3,1) x S^1_R; real scalar with V_bulk = m5^2 phi^2 / 2
hypothesis.brane: SM at y=0; V_H = lambda (H^dagger H - v^2/2)^2; linear scalar Higgs portal
hypothesis.order: tree-level restricted EFT; additional renormalized scalar operators set to zero at the matching scale, not a claim of radiative closure
hypothesis.spectrum: finite cosine tower and zero mode; free sine modes decouple
hypothesis.mass_matching: choose the unmixed Higgs mass parameter to match the lightest mixed eigenmass M_H
hypothesis.domain: R>0; m5>M_H; finite cutoff with all retained eigenmasses below cutoff; positive mass matrix; |mu5/sqrt(cutoff)|<1; N>=1 for a tower, N=0 only as a separate EFT limit
hypothesis.rate_domain: 0 <= kappa <= 1; kappa_V=kappa_F=kappa, universal SM loop amplitudes at this order, no additional Higgs decay width
hypothesis.applicability: one isolated observed Higgs state; no extra contribution to the measured Higgs signal or background templates; detector isolation must be checked before applying results to particular near-degenerate parameter points
hypothesis.heavy_widths: derive on-shell two-scalar partial widths; do not assume heavy total widths or other multibody/off-shell channels vanish

data.required_product: observed joint 95% confidence contour in kappa_V,kappa_F with no invisible or undetected decays
data.version_policy: pin actual raw file SHA-256, bytes, URL, version and qualifiers before evaluation; abort on incompatible assumptions
data.expected_contour_use: not used for observed compatibility decisions
data.raw_data_policy: public collaboration data only; raw files in git-ignored data/external/candidate_b; no plot digitization

method.comparison: intersect the physical diagonal (kappa,kappa), 0<=kappa<=1, with the published observed 95% two-parameter confidence region
method.interpolation: piecewise-linear segments between supplied ordered contour vertices; do not extrapolate a likelihood
method.closure: verify contour ordering and closure; if endpoints are not identical, report the closing-segment length and require it to be comparable to supplied neighboring segments
method.uncertainty: report numerical polygon-intersection precision separately from statistical precision; quote coupling endpoints conservatively at the supplied contour resolution
method.nuisances: use only the collaboration's joint-contour construction; do not reprofile or multiply one-dimensional scans
method.inference: no likelihood reconstruction, no new p-value, no B-specific 95% one-parameter confidence interval, no discovery claim
method.interpretation: outside the supplied joint region means incompatible with that published region under its assumptions, not exclusion of all Candidate B models
method.parameter_translation: conditional on fixed R,m5,cutoff,v,M_H and data applicability; do not choose or optimize these parameters after seeing the contour
stop_conditions: missing provenance or incompatible fit assumptions
unordered, open or self-intersecting contour without a justified interpretation
attempt to turn published intervals or upper limits into likelihood values

full_likelihood_preregistration: not yet frozen; public likelihood, nuisance and confidence-construction qualification still required
